CASE Arms Across Nested Conjunction and Disjunction Lists

CASE Separator Without Outer CASE in Conjunction List
Reject C -> D: the aligned separator cannot continue CASE A,
and there is no outer CASE to receive the arm.

CASE Separator Across Open Parenthesis in Conjunction List
Reject D -> E: it cannot belong to CASE B at that indentation
or cross the open parenthesis to belong to CASE A.
